prompt_text: The first image is the exact orthographic end-elevation silhouette template. Repaint that same complete full-height stair support face for four separate target stair sources. Do not copy source camera or top-down treads; use sources only for materials and details. Output exactly two columns by four rows, on transparent background, no labels: columns FRONT, REAR; rows Early Arenas UP, Early Arenas DOWN, Masquerade UP, Masquerade DOWN matching references 2,3,4,5. EVERY cell must have the first image's full vertical extent, same three full-width horizontal courses, same top-to-ground vertical span, and straight horizontal groundline. The first image is a stepped silhouette and must stay stepped in all cells, not a shallow rectangular half-height wall. Do not draw any tread tops or openings: only the vertical exposed stone support surfaces seen from directly along the stairs' axis. For Early use tan stone, red side blocks, dark blue joints from refs 2–3. For Masquerade use white marble, blue joints, source gold only on the upper end caps from refs 4–5. Keep the full-height outer posts and support down to the groundline. Front and rear may share the same hidden backing if source has no asymmetry; no arbitrary extra decoration. Crisp pixel-art outlines and source texture. Nothing else in cells, no cast shadows or floor.
